name: enrolment-schedule
title: Enrolment schedule draft
for_each: select e.id,e.external_id from enrolments e order by e.external_id

sections.title: Course and dates
sections.note: Schedule for attaching to your reviewed written agreement. Not a government-issued CoE, offer contract or visa approval.

sections.title: Fee schedule
sections.sql: select external_id,description,due_on,currency,amount_cents from v_balances where enrolment_id=$1 order by due_on

name: fee-statement
title: Student fee statement
for_each: select e.id,e.external_id from enrolments e order by e.external_id

sections.title: Student and course
sections.sql: select external_id,student,course,intake from v_enrolments where id=$1

sections.title: Invoices and payments
sections.sql: select external_id,description,due_on,currency,amount_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents from v_balances where enrolment_id=$1 order by due_on
sections.note: Balances reflect recorded receipts. Check against your bank and accounting system.

name: attendance-record
title: Attendance record
for_each: select e.id,e.external_id from enrolments e order by e.external_id

sections.title: Summary
sections.note: Missing marks are unknown. Approved absences remain scheduled contact hours in this base.

sections.title: Daily register
sections.sql: select ss.held_on,ss.minutes scheduled_minutes,a.attended_minutes,a.approved_absence,a.evidence from enrolments e join sessions ss on ss.intake_id=e.intake_id left join attendance a on a.session_id=ss.id and a.enrolment_id=e.id where e.id=$1 and ss.held_on<=current_date order by ss.held_on

name: support-plan
title: Student support review worksheet
for_each: select e.id,e.external_id from enrolments e order by e.external_id

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select rule,finding,source from v_compliance where id=$1
sections.note: A review aid. Not an intention-to-report notice. Staff determine interventions, exceptions and appeal steps.

sections.title: Actions and owners
sections.sql: select reason,owner,due_on,status,resolution from support_cases where enrolment_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Contact history
sections.sql: select body,created_at from notes where enrolment_id=$1 order by created_at
